composition: Stone square, plane trees, and slate roofs above the gulf · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the central square of Makrinitsa, plane trees and a marble fountain sit on a stone terrace, and slate-roofed houses step down the steep slope. Volos is a scatter of lights far below, and the Pagasetic Gulf is dark. The sky over the water stays deep blue. The model cell reads about 6.9°C at about 1469 m, higher than the square.
